result.instructions: Tools for Retainful, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the 20 newest contacts in Retainful and whether they opted in to email."; "Which lists and segments do we have, and what are their ids?"; "Add jane@example.com to the 'Trial started' list with email consent.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Retainful data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run retainful_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run retainful_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run retainful_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. retainful_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: retainful_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (profiles) in the Retainful organization, one page at a time, with consent status and source. Retainful API: GET /customer.

tools.name: retainful_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact (profile) by its Retainful id (contactUUID), with its attributes. Retainful API: GET /customer/{id}.

tools.name: retainful_list_lists
tools.title: List lists and segments
tools.description: List the lists and segments in the organization with their ids. Use the id as list_id in retainful_add_contact_to_list. Retainful API: GET /contact-groups.

type.description: Filter by LIST, SEGMENT, or ALL (default ALL).

tools.name: retainful_get_list
tools.title: Get list
tools.description: Get one list or segment by its id. Retainful API: GET /contact-groups/{id}.

tools.name: retainful_upsert_contact
tools.title: Create or update contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact, or update it when the email or phone already exists. Does not add anyone to a list. email_opt_in is required: it sets marketing consent, so send SUBSCRIBED only with real consent. Needs email or phone. Retainful API: POST /customer/create.

phone.description: Phone number, 7-20 characters, needed for WhatsApp.

email_opt_in.description: Email consent. Use SUBSCRIBED only when the person opted in. NON_SUBSCRIBED = no marketing email. UNSUBSCRIBED = opted out.

phone_opt_in.description: Email consent. Use SUBSCRIBED only when the person opted in. NON_SUBSCRIBED = no marketing email. UNSUBSCRIBED = opted out.

external_id.description: Your own id for this person, e.g. your database id.

source.description: Where the contact came from (default api).

custom_properties.description: Custom fields as string values. Maximum 30 keys.

tools.name: retainful_add_contact_to_list
tools.title: Add contact to list
tools.description: WRITE: create or update a contact by email and add them to a list in one call. A list can start an automation. email_opt_in is required: an existing contact is set to SUBSCRIBED when it is omitted here. Retainful API: POST /contact-groups/{listId}/contacts.

email.description: Email address of the contact (required here).

email_opt_in.description: Email consent. Use SUBSCRIBED only when the person opted in. NON_SUBSCRIBED = no marketing email. UNSUBSCRIBED = opted out.

phone.description: Phone number, 7-20 characters, needed for WhatsApp.

source.description: Where the contact came from (default api).

tools.name: retainful_track_event
tools.title: Track event
tools.description: WRITE: record one event on a contact's timeline. Automations triggered by the event can email the contact. Reuse the same unique_identifier only for a retry of the same real occurrence (a repeat does not trigger automations again); use a new one for each new occurrence. Event data must be flat: strings, numbers, or booleans. Retainful API: POST /events.

event_name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. Appointment Booked. Keep the spelling stable.

unique_identifier.description: Id of this occurrence, e.g. an order or booking id. Idempotency key.

contact_uuid.description: Retainful contact id. Send this, or email or phone.

phone.description: Phone number, 7-20 characters, needed for WhatsApp.

event_data.description: Flat key-value details of the event. At least one key. No nested objects.
